description: Structured Rules Brain rules for PIR v4.2. These rules focus on suspected IPR, low quality, and vulgar/ANSA false-positive control for new-customer product image review.

source_context.price_rpc_current_limit: RPC currently provides min_price, max_price, and currency. For suspected_ipr v4.2, LLM may use broad world knowledge only for rough price reasonableness after a visible global famous brand/IP signal exists.

suspected_ipr.decision_policy: Only route to manual_review for clear high-risk suspected IPR. General globally famous brands/IPs are high risk when price is clearly below 30 percent of normal official/market price level. Luxury brands are also high risk when price is between 30 and 45 percent of normal official/market price level, judged by broad user-facing world knowledge rather than a moderation list. If price is plausibly reasonable or price knowledge is uncertain without another strong risk, downgrade to no_issue/clean to reduce manual review workload. Ordinary related-IP derivative merchandise or fan/collectible-style merchandise sales should not be suspected_ipr by themselves when counterfeit/piracy evidence is not visually clear.
visual_signals: visible globally famous brand logo or brand name
visible globally famous IP character, game, film, sports team, event, or copyrighted packaging
visible globally famous luxury, sportswear, electronics, toy/game, entertainment, or collectible IP mark
required_external_evidence: visible globally famous brand/IP signal in product image
LLM broad world-knowledge assessment of normal official/market price level
LLM broad world-knowledge assessment of whether the visible brand is a luxury brand from ordinary user perspective
manual/GNE confirmation only for high-risk suspected IPR cases

positive_rules.name: Global Famous Brand/IP Scope
positive_rules.rule: Only globally famous brands or globally famous IPs visible in the product image are in suspected_ipr scope. White-label, small, unknown, or ordinary store brands should be skipped.

positive_rules.name: Image-Visible Signal Required
positive_rules.rule: The brand/IP signal must be visible in the product image. Do not create suspected_ipr from product title or category alone.

positive_rules.name: Price Threshold With World Knowledge
positive_rules.rule: If a visible global famous brand/IP signal exists and the current price range is clearly below 30 percent of the normal official/market price level, route to manual_review as suspected_ipr high risk. For luxury brands, also route to manual_review when price is between 30 and 45 percent of normal official/market price level. Luxury brand recognition should use broad user-facing world knowledge, not a moderation list.

positive_rules.name: Luxury Brand 30-45 Percent Rule
positive_rules.rule: For brands commonly recognized by ordinary users as luxury brands, price between 30 and 45 percent of normal official/market price level is enough to route to manual_review as suspected_ipr high risk.

false_positive_rules.name: White Label And Small Brand Exclusion
false_positive_rules.rule: Do not mark suspected_ipr for white-label, small, unknown, or ordinary store brands even if the image contains a logo or brand-like mark.

false_positive_rules.name: No Image Signal No IPR
false_positive_rules.rule: Do not mark suspected_ipr when the global famous brand/IP appears only in title, category, or model guess, but not visibly in the image.

false_positive_rules.name: Uncertain Price Is Not Enough
false_positive_rules.rule: If the normal official/market price level is uncertain, if the product variant/SKU is unclear, or if the brand luxury status is uncertain for the 30-45 percent luxury rule, do not route to manual_review unless there is another strong visual counterfeit/piracy signal. Downgrade to no_issue/clean.

false_positive_rules.name: Reasonable Price Range Downgrade
false_positive_rules.rule: If the price range is plausibly reasonable for the visible brand/product family, downgrade to no_issue/clean even when a famous brand/IP signal is visible.

false_positive_rules.name: Related IP Derivative Merchandise Exclusion
false_positive_rules.rule: Do not route ordinary related-IP derivative merchandise, fan merchandise, celebrity/character-inspired dolls, plush, cards, stickers, toys, or collectibles to suspected_ipr/manual_review by default. If the image shows derivative merchandise sales but no clear counterfeit/piracy signal and no clearly abnormal price risk, downgrade to no_issue/clean.

false_positive_rules.name: Uncertain Character Identity Or Reasonable Price
false_positive_rules.rule: If the visible character/IP identity is uncertain, resembles a known IP only weakly, or the price range is reasonable for derivative merchandise, do not keep suspected_ipr. Downgrade to no_issue/clean unless another strong visual counterfeit/piracy signal exists.

suspected_ipr.output_guidance: Use suspected_ipr manual_review only for high-risk globally famous brand/IP cases. High risk means visible global famous brand/IP plus price clearly below 30 percent of normal official/market price level; for luxury brands, 30-45 percent also qualifies. Luxury brand recognition is based on broad user-facing world knowledge, not a moderation list. If price is plausibly reasonable or price/luxury/SKU knowledge is uncertain, downgrade to no_issue/clean unless another strong counterfeit/piracy signal exists. Related-IP derivative merchandise sales should be clean/no_issue unless clear counterfeit/piracy evidence is visible.
not_in_scope: generic design similarities without a globally famous brand/IP signal
brand mentioned only in product title or category but not visible in image
ordinary related-IP derivative merchandise without clear counterfeit/piracy evidence
fan merchandise or collectible-style products when price is reasonable or IP identity is uncertain
suspected_ipr.price_assessment_policy: Use current price range only after a visible global famous brand/IP signal exists in the image. Use broad model world knowledge to estimate normal official/market price level and whether the brand is luxury from a user perspective. General threshold: below 30 percent. Luxury threshold: 30-45 percent also high risk. If not confident, do not route to manual_review unless there is another strong visual counterfeit/piracy signal.

low_quality.decision_policy: Only mark low_quality when the product subject is hard to recognize.

positive_rules.name: Product Subject Unrecognizable
positive_rules.rule: Mark low_quality when users cannot clearly recognize what product is being sold.

positive_rules.name: Material Obstruction
positive_rules.rule: Mark low_quality when stickers, banners, text, darkness, blur, crop, or background materially block or overwhelm the product subject.

positive_rules.name: Information Overwhelming
positive_rules.rule: Mark low_quality when excessive text/icons/graphics make the product subject difficult to identify quickly.

false_positive_rules.name: Marketing Elements Not Enough
false_positive_rules.rule: Promotional banners, TikTok Shop labels, seller badges, discount stickers, event frames, brand logos, and light watermarks are not low_quality by themselves.

false_positive_rules.name: Subject Still Clear
false_positive_rules.rule: If the product subject remains clear and identifiable, do not mark low_quality only because the image is visually busy or promotional.

false_positive_rules.name: Watermark Scope Exclusion
false_positive_rules.rule: Watermark is not a standalone in-scope issue for this workflow. Only consider it under low_quality if it materially blocks product recognition.

low_quality.output_guidance: State whether the product subject is recognizable. If yes, do not mark low_quality.

new_issue_supplement.decision_policy: Use new_issue_supplement only when there is a clear visible image issue that is not covered by any allowed issue type. It is not a bucket for uncertainty, weak policy concern, category-only concern, or health supplement category concern.

positive_rules.name: Clear Uncovered Visible Issue
positive_rules.rule: Mark new_issue_supplement only when the product image has a concrete visible risk that cannot be categorized as low_quality, vulgar/ANSA, uncomfortable, no_package, prohibited, suspected_ipr, or another allowed issue type.

false_positive_rules.name: Health Supplement Is Not New Issue
false_positive_rules.rule: Do not mark health supplements, nutrition supplements, pills, vitamins, protein products, or ordinary supplement packaging as new_issue_supplement by category alone. If no other visible in-scope issue exists, output no_issue/clean.

false_positive_rules.name: Uncertainty Is Not New Issue
false_positive_rules.rule: Do not use new_issue_supplement for uncertain policy scope, missing evidence, unclear image, or weak suspicion. Downgrade to no_issue/clean unless a specific visible issue is stated.

new_issue_supplement.output_guidance: If choosing new_issue_supplement, name the exact visible issue and explain why no existing allowed issue type fits. Health or supplement category alone should be no_issue/clean.

no_package.decision_policy: Mark no_package when edible food is visibly sold or presented without packaging in a way that creates hygiene or platform trust risk. If the product cover image uses exposed food as the selling display and there is no visible protective packaging, treat it as no_package rather than ordinary serving context.

positive_rules.name: Unpackaged Food
positive_rules.rule: Mark no_package when the product image clearly shows food directly exposed without protective packaging, wrapping, sealed container, or hygienic presentation.

positive_rules.name: Cover Image Exposed Food
positive_rules.rule: Mark no_package when the cover image sells edible food through exposed food display without visible protective packaging, even if the food is on a tray, paper cup, plate, or other non-sealed presentation that still creates hygiene or platform trust risk.

false_positive_rules.name: Packaged Or Serving Context
false_positive_rules.rule: Do not mark no_package when food is visibly packaged, sealed, or the lack of packaging is not clear from the image. Normal serving/tableware context is only a false-positive boundary when the image is not using exposed food as the product cover selling point.

no_package.output_guidance: Use no_package for clearly unpackaged food rather than no_issue. Describe the visible lack of packaging.

uncomfortable.decision_policy: Mark uncomfortable when the image intentionally uses strong disgust, grotesque, uncanny, body-condition anxiety, mortality-related, or physically uncomfortable visuals as the selling point.

positive_rules.name: Disgust As Selling Point
positive_rules.rule: Mark uncomfortable when the product image uses disgusting, nauseating, grotesque, or body-horror-like visual effect as a main selling point, even if the product category itself is otherwise allowed.

positive_rules.name: Uncanny Body Or Fluid Visual
positive_rules.rule: Mark uncomfortable for uncanny body parts, realistic organs, realistic teeth/eyes/tongue, body fluids, feces/vomit simulation, gore, or similar strong discomfort cues.

positive_rules.name: Body-Condition Discomfort Selling Point
positive_rules.rule: Mark uncomfortable when severe hair loss, exposed scalp thinning, hair shedding, bald patches, dandruff-like scalp debris, disturbing before/after body-condition contrast, or similar body-condition anxiety visual is used as the main selling point.

positive_rules.name: Skeleton Or Mortality Visual Shock
positive_rules.rule: Mark uncomfortable when skeleton, skull, death, or mortality-related imagery creates immediate visual discomfort as the product selling point, even if it is Halloween-themed, when the first-view effect is strongly unsettling for new users.

false_positive_rules.name: Cute Or Normal Creative Design
false_positive_rules.rule: Do not mark uncomfortable for normal cute-style, ordinary Halloween, ordinary hair-care packaging, mild non-graphic hair comparison, medical/education models, or harmless creative design unless realistic disgust, strong body-condition discomfort, or strong uncanny effect is clear.

false_positive_rules.name: Medical Education Exemption Boundary
false_positive_rules.rule: The medical/education exemption does not apply when a commercial product ad uses unpleasant body-condition visuals, such as severe hair loss or exposed scalp, as persuasion for the product.

uncomfortable.output_guidance: If the visible product appeal is to make users feel grossed out or uncomfortable, keep uncomfortable instead of no_issue.

new_guest_vulgar_visual.display_name: 新客低俗色情/边缘性感画风
new_guest_vulgar_visual.decision_policy: Use this layer for new-user visual strategy intervention when the image may affect first-time user perception but does not meet strict vulgar/ANSA criteria. Buttock-focused shapewear, leggings, underwear-like display, mannequin lower-body display, silicone shaping garment, or body-enhancing product display should usually stay in new_guest_vulgar_visual when there is no explicit private-part exposure, sexual act, adult product use scenario, or explicit nudity.

positive_rules.name: New Guest Body Focus
positive_rules.rule: Buttock-focused fashion display, deep-V clothing, sexy apparel, tight leggings/shorts, and adult-oriented products can be new_guest_vulgar_visual when they are unsuitable for new-user recommendation.

positive_rules.name: Adult-Oriented Product
positive_rules.rule: Adult-oriented products or sexual-style apparel may be routed to new_guest_vulgar_visual when not explicit enough for strict vulgar/ANSA.

positive_rules.name: Shapewear Or Mannequin Lower-Body Display
positive_rules.rule: Route buttock-focused shapewear, leggings, underwear-like display, mannequin lower-body display, silicone shaping garment, or body-enhancing product display to new_guest_vulgar_visual when the concern is new-user visual suitability and there is no explicit private-part exposure, sexual activity, adult product use scenario, or explicit nudity.

false_positive_rules.name: Not Strict Violation
false_positive_rules.rule: Do not label borderline sexy apparel as strict vulgar solely because it is sexy or body-fitting.

false_positive_rules.name: Adult Or Existing-User Unsuitable Content
false_positive_rules.rule: Do not keep new_guest_vulgar_visual when the visible image contains explicit adult product use/display, explicit private-part exposure, sexual activity, or explicit nudity that is unsuitable for both new and existing users. Do not upgrade to strict_vulgar_or_ansa only because the image is body-focused, buttock-focused, nude-like mannequin-style, shapewear-focused, or visually sexy.

new_guest_vulgar_visual.output_guidance: Separate this from strict_vulgar_or_ansa. This is for new-user strategy intervention.

strict_vulgar_or_ansa.display_name: 严格低俗色情/成人露骨问题
strict_vulgar_or_ansa.decision_policy: Strict vulgar/ANSA requires explicit evidence, not general sexy apparel display. Do not upgrade body-focused or shapewear/mannequin display to strict_vulgar_or_ansa unless explicit private-part exposure, sexual activity, adult product use/display, explicit nudity, or clear sexualized graphics/text is visible.

positive_rules.name: Sexualized Body-Part Focus
positive_rules.rule: Mark strict vulgar when the image clearly focuses on sexualized body parts rather than product display.

positive_rules.name: Private-Part Exposure
positive_rules.rule: Mark strict vulgar/ANSA for explicit private-part exposure, clear nipple/genital/anus exposure, full nude buttocks with complete butt crack, or explicit adult nudity.

positive_rules.name: Explicit Adult Activity
positive_rules.rule: Mark ANSA for explicit sexual activity, masturbation, simulated intercourse, or explicit adult product use/display.

positive_rules.name: Clear Sexualized Graphic/Text
positive_rules.rule: Mark strict vulgar when product graphics or text clearly depict sexual acts, explicit sexualized characters, or private-part imagery.

positive_rules.name: Adult Product Or Nude-Like Existing-User Risk
positive_rules.rule: Mark strict_vulgar_or_ansa when the product image clearly shows an adult-oriented product use/display, explicit nude exposure, private-part imagery, sexual act, or sexualized imagery that is unsuitable for both new and existing users, even if the previous borderline layer would have been new_guest_vulgar_visual.

false_positive_rules.name: Normal Apparel Display
false_positive_rules.rule: Normal apparel display, sexy clothing, deep-V clothing, leggings, shorts, swimwear, body-fit clothing, and normal underwear display are not strict vulgar by themselves.

false_positive_rules.name: Product Display Dominates
false_positive_rules.rule: If the image subject is still clearly apparel/product display and there is no explicit private-part exposure or sexual act, downgrade from strict vulgar.

false_positive_rules.name: Weak Metaphor
false_positive_rules.rule: Weak sexual metaphor or ordinary product demonstration should not be strict vulgar unless the sexual intent is explicit in composition, text, or use scenario.

false_positive_rules.name: Body-Focused Display Not Enough
false_positive_rules.rule: Do not upgrade to strict_vulgar_or_ansa only because the image is body-focused, buttock-focused, nude-like mannequin-style, shapewear-focused, silicone shaping-product-focused, or visually sexy. Without explicit private-part exposure, sexual activity, explicit adult product use/display, or explicit nudity, route to new_guest_vulgar_visual instead.

strict_vulgar_or_ansa.output_guidance: If the case is borderline or only unsuitable for new users, route to new_guest_vulgar_visual instead of strict_vulgar_or_ansa.

prohibited.decision_policy: Current PIR strategy includes weapon-related risk and realistic replica currency risk. For weapon-related risk, mark prohibited only when the image shows a functional weapon, a realistic usable weapon replica, or firearm-like product without clear toy, water-play, decorative, miniature, jewelry, charm, or ornament context. Mark prohibited when the product image visibly shows realistic banknotes, replica currency, prop money, copy money, motion-picture banknotes, or similar money-like items that may create counterfeit-currency or misuse risk.

positive_rules.name: Weapon-Related Prohibited Risk
positive_rules.rule: Mark prohibited when the image visibly shows functional weapons, realistic usable weapon replicas, firearm-like products, or weapon-related items that create platform risk and are not clearly toy, water-play, decorative, miniature, jewelry, charm, or ornament products.

positive_rules.name: Replica Currency Or Prop Money
positive_rules.rule: Mark prohibited when the image shows realistic-looking banknotes, replica currency, prop money, copy money, motion-picture banknotes, or similar money-like items that may create counterfeit-currency or misuse risk. This rule applies even when the item is labeled COPY, prop, movie, novelty, educational, or play money if it visually resembles real currency.

false_positive_rules.name: Non-Realistic Toy Boundary
false_positive_rules.rule: Do not mark prohibited for clearly non-realistic toy money, cartoon money, game tokens, or decorative money patterns that ordinary users would not confuse with real currency.

false_positive_rules.name: Water Gun And Toy Blaster Boundary
false_positive_rules.rule: Do not mark prohibited for water gun, high pressure water gun, toy blaster, toy foam dart gun, or clearly labeled toy/water-play products when the visual design is clearly non-real firearm and the product context is toy or water play.

false_positive_rules.name: Decorative Miniature Weapon-Shaped Boundary
false_positive_rules.rule: Do not mark prohibited for clearly decorative weapon-shaped products, miniature weapon charms, jewelry, ornaments, copper/brass decorative gun items, dollhouse accessories, collectibles, or toys when they are visibly non-functional and not realistic usable weapons.

prohibited.output_guidance: Use prohibited for visible replica currency or realistic prop money rather than suspected_ipr or no_issue. For weapon-shaped products, first check whether the image clearly indicates water gun, toy, decorative, miniature, jewelry, charm, ornament, or non-functional accessory context; if so, downgrade to no_issue/clean. Explain the visible currency-like or weapon-like evidence, including COPY or motion-picture markings when present.

sensitive_word.decision_policy: Mark sensitive_word when OCR-visible text contains political sensitive words, hate or insulting words, prohibited sensitive text, or other high-risk text that is not better categorized as crude sexual/vulgar wording.

positive_rules.name: Visible Sensitive Text
positive_rules.rule: Mark sensitive_word when image text visibly contains political sensitive words, hate or insulting words, or clearly prohibited sensitive wording.

false_positive_rules.name: Unreadable Or Inferred Text
false_positive_rules.rule: Do not mark sensitive_word from unreadable, inferred, title-only, or category-only text. Use OCR-visible image text only.

sensitive_word.output_guidance: Quote or summarize the visible text that triggered sensitive_word.

crude.decision_policy: Mark crude when visible product image text or graphics use profanity, sexual insult, vulgar slang, crude wording, sexual pun, or explicit double meaning that is not already strict_vulgar_or_ansa.

positive_rules.name: Visible Profanity Or Vulgar Slang
positive_rules.rule: Visible profanity, sexual insult, vulgar slang, or crude wording should be marked crude when it is part of the product image text. Words such as bitch should normally trigger crude unless the case is covered by an explicit brand whitelist.

positive_rules.name: Sexual Pun Or Double Meaning
positive_rules.rule: Mark crude when visible text or graphic uses a clear sexual pun, vulgar metaphor, or double meaning, even if it is presented as a joke product.

false_positive_rules.name: Weak Or Ambiguous Association
false_positive_rules.rule: Do not mark crude from weak, ambiguous, or inferred association when the visible text itself is not profane or sexually/vulgarly meaningful.

false_positive_rules.name: PLOUISE Brand Whitelist
false_positive_rules.rule: PLOUISE brand phrase Bad Bitch Energy is currently whitelisted as no_issue based on human review feedback. This is a narrow brand whitelist and must not be generalized to other brands or other uses of bitch.

crude.output_guidance: Use crude for visible profanity or vulgar slang. Mention if the narrow PLOUISE brand whitelist applies.

lgbt_related.decision_policy: For current strategy, explicit LGBT-related visual/text elements that are central to the product concept should be marked lgbt_related as new-guest-only policy-pending risk. Do not downgrade only because the item is novelty, joke-card, meme, or collectible merchandise when the LGBT signal is explicit and central.

positive_rules.name: Explicit LGBT Identity Text Or Symbol
positive_rules.rule: Prominent LGBT identity text or symbols used as the core product message should be marked lgbt_related. Examples include GAY, LGBT, PRIDE, lesbian, bisexual, transgender, queer, or a clearly recognizable six-color Pride/rainbow flag.

positive_rules.name: Central Product Concept
positive_rules.rule: Mark lgbt_related when LGBT wording, Pride flag usage, or sexual-orientation/gender-identity reference is the main product message, not a tiny incidental decoration.

false_positive_rules.name: Generic Rainbow Boundary
false_positive_rules.rule: Do not mark generic rainbow colors, decorative gradients, sci-fi rainbow patterns, or ordinary colorful design as lgbt_related unless there is a clear LGBT identity signal such as LGBT wording, Pride flag usage, or explicit sexual-orientation/gender-identity reference.

false_positive_rules.name: Novelty Is Not Exemption
false_positive_rules.rule: Novelty, joke-card, meme, or collectible presentation is not a false-positive exemption for lgbt_related when the LGBT signal is explicit and central to the product.

lgbt_related.output_guidance: If the image prominently shows terms like GAY or a six-color Pride/rainbow flag as the product concept, use lgbt_related with business_layer policy_pending or new_guest_only rather than no_issue.

novelty.decision_policy: Mark novelty for products designed mainly for shock, controversy, or platform-unfriendly novelty that may harm ordinary user experience and are not better covered by uncomfortable, crude, prohibited, lgbt_related, or another allowed issue type.

positive_rules.name: Shock Or Controversy Novelty
positive_rules.rule: Mark novelty when the product concept is mainly shock, controversy, or platform-unfriendly novelty and no more specific allowed issue type fits.

false_positive_rules.name: Use Specific Type First
false_positive_rules.rule: Do not use novelty as a downgrade or false-positive exemption when a more specific positive rule is met, such as lgbt_related, crude, prohibited, no_package, or uncomfortable.

novelty.output_guidance: Use novelty only after checking more specific issue types.

child_sexualization.decision_policy: Child sexualization remains highest priority and must be marked whenever visible child or child-like figures are sexualized.

positive_rules.name: Sexualized Child Or Child-Like Figure
positive_rules.rule: Mark child_sexualization for any sexualized child model, child-like cartoon character in sexualized pose, child-like character with sexualized body features, or child image in adult sexual context.

false_positive_rules.name: No Sexualization
false_positive_rules.rule: Do not mark child_sexualization when the image shows ordinary child-related products or child-like characters without sexual pose, sexual context, or sexualized body features.

child_sexualization.output_guidance: When child_sexualization is suspected, mark has_problem true and route for serious review.

politically_sensitive.decision_policy: Mark politically_sensitive when visible image elements contain sensitive political symbols, flags, figures, slogans, or event-related content.

positive_rules.name: Visible Political Sensitive Content
positive_rules.rule: Mark politically_sensitive when image visibly contains sensitive political symbols, flags, figures, slogans, or event-related content.

false_positive_rules.name: Do Not Infer Politics
false_positive_rules.rule: Do not mark politically_sensitive from title/category, inferred context, or generic national colors when no visible sensitive political content exists.

politically_sensitive.output_guidance: Use visible evidence only and state the visible political signal.
